items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 aggregate row is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is reported as $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align; AI cost is reported as $886.12 across 4,865 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27 but retained records conflict; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and defined learning-outcome records are incomplete. Do not authorize spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims. Impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, orders, shipped items, performance scores, and AI usage are not financial returns. Continue only existing attribution and cost reconciliation. Minimum measurement: period-aligned site/content revenue by tracking ID; one reconciled AI-cost ledger; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and learning-outcome records for the same period; and a defined cost-to-learn threshold.
